# Nikhil Sahani (`h4r0015k`)

> Senior Product Engineer based in Thane / Mumbai, India. Focused on distributed backends, concurrency, high-scale caching, and applied AI workflows. 7+ years of production experience.

## Executive Summary
Nikhil Sahani is a software engineer with 7+ years of experience building resilient backend services, distributed systems, and web applications. He has been tinkering with computers and code long before formal employment, starting with C socket programming and network protocol reverse-engineering. In production, his work centers on high-concurrency systems, edge caching for breaking news traffic surges (50M+ daily hits), financial transaction safety (zero double-spends via Redis distributed locks and atomic SQL invariants), and pragmatic applied AI pipelines.

## Key Engineering Competencies
- Distributed Systems & Databases: PostgreSQL (ACID, MVCC, index tuning), Redis (distributed mutexes with atomic Lua scripts, multi-tier caching topologies), Apache Kafka.
- Languages & Runtimes: TypeScript / Node.js, Go (concurrency, worker pools), C (ANSI C, POSIX BSD raw sockets), Python.
- Cloud & Infrastructure: Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Run scale-to-zero, IAM), Docker containerization, Linux internals (TCP 5-tuple, socket states), GitHub Actions CI/CD.
- Applied AI: Pragmatic LLM integrations, agentic workflows, structured output parsing, eval pipelines, tool-use orchestration.
- Architectural Focus: Idempotent APIs, double-entry ledgers, circuit breaker patterns, stale-while-revalidate edge caching, client-side zero-knowledge cryptography.

## Featured Software Projects
- **Mountain**: Local-first, zero-knowledge browser password vault. Uses the Web Crypto API with AES-256-GCM encryption, PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 key derivation, deterministic 12-word BIP-39 mnemonic recovery, and IndexedDB local storage. Zero sync servers, zero tracking, zero external network dependencies.
  - Live Application: https://nikhilsahani.com/Mountain/
  - Source Repository: https://github.com/h4r0015k/Mountain
- **IRCBot-C**: Minimalist IRC client written from scratch in ANSI C using raw POSIX/BSD sockets. Handles direct TCP streams, non-blocking I/O polling, and RFC 1459 protocol PING/PONG keep-alive loops without third-party libraries.
  - Source Repository: https://github.com/h4r0015k/IRCBot-C
- **WhatBot**: Early automated WhatsApp cryptocurrency micro-tipping bot (2015). Interfaced with the WhatsApp protocol via Yowsup, managing transaction state in MySQL and programmatic disbursements with Block.io APIs.
  - Source Repository: https://github.com/h4r0015k/WhatBot

## Foundational Books & Influences
- **The C Programming Language** (Brian W. Kernighan & Dennis M. Ritchie): Canonical systems programming text that established an appreciation for memory layout, pointer mechanics, and bare-metal discipline.
- **C For Dummies** (Dan Gookin): The original starting point that demystified computers in youth and sparked a lifelong path in software engineering.

## Engineering Philosophy
- Simple, "boring" architectures with well-understood failure modes beat complex distributed topologies.
- Invariants must hold at the persistence layer (conditional SQL decrements, idempotency keys), not just in memory.
- Low operational drag: systems should be deterministic and run quietly without midnight pages.
